name: After Hours Music Player Plugin
author: Jason Cross (jcross)
description: Plays internet radio streams you choose (for example outside show hours) through FPP's audio output. The player connects only to the stream addresses you add, to check they are reachable and to play them.

privacy.summary: Connects only to the internet radio stream addresses you add, to check they respond and to play them. Nothing else leaves the player.

sends.to: the internet radio stream addresses you add
sends.what: a normal request to fetch or check the stream
sends.why: to play the stream and detect when it has stopped

systemChanges.what: Adds fpp-after-hours-pulse.service, a PulseAudio socket for mpd on FPP's PipeWire, started with fpp-pipewire.service
Runs mpd as the fpp user (systemd drop-in), edits /etc/mpd.conf, and enables mpd.service
Adds /etc/cron.d/fpp-after-hours-cron, a once-a-minute check that restarts a stalled stream
Gives /var/lib/mpd and /var/log/mpd to the fpp user (returned to mpd on uninstall)

privacy.other: Uninstall removes everything above and restores the packaged /etc/mpd.conf. Streams and settings in plugindata are kept. The plugin's API (start, stop, volume, stream list) can be called by anyone who can reach FPP.
